items.title: Qwen VLo: From “Understanding” the World to “Depicting” It
items.raw_content: QWEN CHAT DISCORD Introduction The evolution of multimodal large models is continually pushing the boundaries of what we believe technology can achieve. From the initial QwenVL to the latest Qwen2.5 VL, we have made progress in enhancing the model’s ability to understand image content. Today, we are excited to introduce a new model, Qwen VLo, a unified multimodal understanding and generation model. This newly upgraded model not only “understands” the world but also generates high-quality recreations based on that understanding, truly bridging the gap between perception and creation.
items.title_zh: Qwen VLo：从“理解”世界到“描绘”世界
items.summary: Qwen VLo is a newly introduced unified multimodal model that both understands images and generates high-quality recreations based on that understanding.

items.title: Towards Transparent AI: A Survey on Explainable Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 迈向透明 AI：可解释大语言模型综述

items.title: The Application of Large Language Models on Major Depressive Disorder Support Based on African Natural Products
items.title_zh: 基于非洲天然产物的大语言模型重度抑郁症支持应用
items.summary: The paper reviews African medicinal plants with reported antidepressant properties and describes an AI support system built on DeepSeek's language model that provides information on herbal treatments, safety and therapeutic protocols.

items.title: Bayesian Evolutionary Swarm Architecture: A Formal Epistemic System Grounded in Truth-Based Competition
items.title_zh: 贝叶斯进化群体架构：以真值竞争为基础的形式化认知系统
items.summary: The paper proposes a mathematically formal architecture of probabilistic agents that evolve through structured competition and belief revision against a fixed ground-truth oracle, with theorems on convergence, robustness and evolutionary stability.

items.title: Learning Instruction-Following Policies through Open-Ended Instruction Relabeling with Large Language Models
items.title_zh: 借助大语言模型进行开放式指令重标注以学习指令遵循策略
items.summary: The authors use LLMs to generate open-ended instructions retrospectively from collected agent trajectories, relabeling unsuccessful trajectories to reduce reliance on human annotations; in Craftax the approach improved sample efficiency, instruction coverage, and policy performance.

items.title: M3PO: Massively Multi-Task Model-Based Policy Optimization
items.title_zh: M3PO：大规模多任务基于模型的策略优化
items.summary: M3PO is a model-based reinforcement learning framework that combines an implicit world model with hybrid exploration, reporting state-of-the-art results across multiple benchmarks.

items.title: Inpainting is All You Need: A Diffusion-based Augmentation Method for Semi-supervised Medical Image Segmentation
items.title_zh: 图像修复就够了：一种基于扩散的半监督医学图像分割数据增强方法
items.summary: The authors present AugPaint, which uses latent diffusion inpainting to generate image-label pairs from limited labeled data, and report improvements over state-of-the-art label-efficient methods on four public CT, MRI and skin imaging datasets.

items.title: Why Settle for Mid: A Probabilistic Viewpoint to Spatial Relationship Alignment in Text-to-image Models
items.title_zh: 何必满足于中等：文本到图像模型空间关系对齐的概率视角
items.summary: The paper introduces a probabilistic framework based on Probability of Superiority for spatial relations in text-to-image generation, along with a new evaluation metric and an inference-time method that improves 2D and 3D spatial alignment without fine-tuning.

items.title: THIRDEYE: Cue-Aware Monocular Depth Estimation via Brain-Inspired Multi-Stage Fusion
items.title_zh: THIRDEYE：基于线索感知与类脑多阶段融合的单目深度估计
items.summary: ThirdEye is a monocular depth estimation pipeline that supplies explicit cues through separate pre-trained, frozen networks and fuses them in a three-stage, brain-inspired V1-to-V3 hierarchy. A key-value working-memory module weights cues by reliability before an adaptive-bins transformer head produces a high-resolution disparity map.
